"""Verify the fixed-prefix termination diagnostic and its registered gate."""

import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import math
import statistics
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from audit_whole_model_replay import digest, read, verified_receipt


ARMS = tuple(f"{arm}_{size}" for arm in ("exact", "compressed", "rotated", "exact_with_eos")
             for size in ("full", "quarter"))


def audit(work):
    adaptation_path = work / "adaptation.json"
    observed = read(adaptation_path)
    result = read(work / "termination.json")
    assert result["adaptation_sha256"] == digest(adaptation_path)
    assert result["candidate_writes_sha256"] == observed["candidate_writes"]["sha256"]
    assert result["checkpoint_sha256"] == observed["checkpoint_sha256"] and result["content_stride"] == 32
    assert result["matched_support_sha256"] == [batch["support_sha256"] for batch in observed["replay_batches"]]
    assert result["eos_ids"] == [151645, 151643]
    assert 0 <= result["eos_to_content_numerator_norm"] and -1 <= result["combined_direction_cosine"] <= 1.000001
    expected = {}
    for index, item in enumerate(observed["observations"]):
        batch = observed["replay_batches"][index // 8]
        width = len(batch["prompt_attention"][0])
        baseline = statistics.mean(item["rewards"])
        for sample, length in enumerate(item["lengths"]):
            row = (index % 8) * 4 + sample
            for step in (*range(31, length, 32), length):
                kind = "eos" if step == length else "content"
                token = batch["sequences"][row][width + step]
                expected[(item["id"], sample, step, kind)] = (row, item["rewards"][sample], item["rewards"][sample] - baseline, token)
    records = result["records"]
    for item in records:
        key = (item["question"], item["sample"], item["step"], item["kind"])
        assert expected.pop(key) == (item["row"], item["reward"], item["centered_reward"], item["action"])
        assert 0 <= item["zero_eos_mass"] <= 1.000001
        if item["kind"] == "eos":
            assert item["action"] in result["eos_ids"] and item["zero_eos_mass"] > 0
        for arm in ARMS:
            measure = item[arm]
            assert 0 <= measure["eos_mass"] <= 1.000001
            assert math.isfinite(measure["fixed_support_kl"]) and measure["fixed_support_kl"] >= 0
            assert isinstance(measure["dynamic_support_changed"], bool)
    assert not expected
    eos = [row for row in records if row["kind"] == "eos"]
    content = [row for row in records if row["kind"] == "content"]
    successful_mixed = [row for row in eos if row["reward"] == 1 and row["centered_reward"] != 0]
    assert len(eos) == 64 and len(successful_mixed) > 0 and len(content) > 0
    summaries = {}
    for arm in ARMS:
        summaries[arm] = {
            "mean_stop_mass_at_eos": statistics.mean(row[arm]["eos_mass"] for row in eos),
            "mean_stop_mass_successful_mixed": statistics.mean(row[arm]["eos_mass"] for row in successful_mixed),
            "mean_content_kl": statistics.mean(row[arm]["fixed_support_kl"] for row in content),
            "changed_content_supports": sum(row[arm]["dynamic_support_changed"] for row in content),
            "changed_eos_supports": sum(row[arm]["dynamic_support_changed"] for row in eos),
        }
    exact, amended = summaries["exact_full"], summaries["exact_with_eos_full"]
    eos_change = amended["mean_stop_mass_successful_mixed"] - exact["mean_stop_mass_successful_mixed"]
    kl_ratio = amended["mean_content_kl"] / exact["mean_content_kl"]
    qualifies = eos_change >= 0.01 and kl_ratio <= 1.1
    return {"content_prefixes": len(content), "eos_prefixes": len(eos),
            "successful_mixed_eos_prefixes": len(successful_mixed),
            "zero_mean_eos_mass": statistics.mean(row["zero_eos_mass"] for row in eos),
            "zero_mean_eos_mass_successful_mixed": statistics.mean(row["zero_eos_mass"] for row in successful_mixed),
            "arms": summaries, "registered_eos_mass_change": eos_change, "registered_content_kl_ratio": kl_ratio,
            "registered_direction_passes": qualifies}


def publish(work, registration, source_hash, output):
    audited = audit(work)
    assert audited == read(work / "eos_audit.json")
    raw_path = work / "termination.json"
    raw = read(raw_path)
    scripts = ("eos_credit_diagnostic.py", "eos_support_fixture.py", "eos_support_fixture_first.py", "audit_eos_credit.py")
    sources = {name: {"sha256": digest(work / name), "content": (work / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8")}
               for name in scripts}
    assert sources[scripts[0]]["sha256"] == source_hash
    receipts = {name: verified_receipt(work / (name + ".json")) for name in
                ("qwen-eos-credit-fixed-prefix", "qwen-eos-support-fixture-reference", "qwen-eos-credit-independent-audit")}
    file = work / "qwen-eos-support-fixture.json"
    fixture = read(file)
    assert fixture["status"] == "failure"
    packed = gzip.compress(raw_path.read_bytes(), compresslevel=9, mtime=0)
    assert json.loads(gzip.decompress(packed)) == raw
    report = {key: value for key, value in raw.items() if key != "records"}
    report.update({"registered_protocol": registration, "summary": audited, "sources": sources, "dsr": receipts,
                   "records_archive_sha256": hashlib.sha256(packed).hexdigest(),
                   "first_fixture_attempt": {"run_id": fixture["run_id"], "status": fixture["status"],
                                             "receipt_sha256": digest(file),
                                             "cause": "The fixture boost did not put EOS over the expected 0.5 probability"}})
    with output.with_suffix(".json.gz").open("xb") as stream:
        stream.write(packed)
    with output.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(report, stream, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False, indent=2)
        stream.write("\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if not __debug__:
        raise RuntimeError("The fixed-prefix audit requires Python assertions.")
    if sys.argv[1] == "publish":
        publish(Path(sys.argv[2]), sys.argv[3], sys.argv[4], Path(sys.argv[5]))
    else:
        directory = Path(sys.argv[1])
        result = audit(directory)
        with (directory / "eos_audit.json").open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            json.dump(result, stream, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
            stream.write("\n")

"""Measure termination and KL at fixed archived Qwen prefixes."""

import json
import sys
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

import torch
from rich.console import Console
from safetensors.torch import load
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM
from transformers.cache_utils import DynamicCache

from ladder_audit import fingerprint, read
from qualify_single_write import support_identity
from qwen_external import LFS_SHA, REVISION, verify
from sampler_score import analytical_feedback


EOS = (151645, 151643)
STRIDE = 32
K = 50


def rank_mask(raw):
    logits = raw.float()
    return logits.masked_fill(logits < logits.topk(K).values[:, -1:], -torch.inf)


def event_plan(batch, cases):
    width = len(batch["prompt_attention"][0])
    plan = defaultdict(list)
    caps = []
    for slot, case in enumerate(cases):
        rewards = case["rewards"]
        for sample, length in enumerate(case["lengths"]):
            row = slot * 4 + sample
            caps.append(length)
            token = batch["sequences"][row][width + length]
            assert token in EOS and length < 512
            identity = {"question": case["id"], "sample": sample, "row": row, "reward": rewards[sample],
                        "centered_reward": rewards[sample] - sum(rewards) / 4}
            plan[length].append({**identity, "kind": "eos", "step": length, "action": token})
            for step in range(STRIDE - 1, length, STRIDE):
                plan[step].append({**identity, "kind": "content", "step": step,
                                   "action": batch["sequences"][row][width + step]})
    return plan, caps


def capture(model, batch, cases):
    plan, caps = event_plan(batch, cases)
    device = model.device
    limit = max(caps) + 1
    base_attention = torch.tensor(batch["prompt_attention"], device=device).repeat_interleave(4, dim=0)
    width = base_attention.shape[1]
    tokens = torch.tensor(batch["sequences"], device=device)[:, :width + limit - 1]
    attention = torch.cat((base_attention, base_attention.new_ones((32, limit - 1))), dim=-1)
    positions = (attention.cumsum(-1) - 1).masked_fill(attention == 0, 0)
    layer = model.model.layers[-1]
    cache = DynamicCache(config=model.config)
    partial, data, scores = {}, [], []
    step = 0

    def residual_hook(_, args):
        if step in plan:
            partial["before"] = args[0].clone()

    def down_hook(_, args, output):
        if step in plan:
            partial["x"] = args[0].clone()
            partial["down"] = output.clone()

    hooks = (layer.post_attention_layernorm.register_forward_pre_hook(residual_hook),
             layer.mlp.down_proj.register_forward_hook(down_hook))
    try:
        for step in range(limit):
            end = width + step
            kw = model.prepare_inputs_for_generation(
                tokens[:, :end], next_sequence_length=1 if step else width,
                attention_mask=attention[:, :end].contiguous(), position_ids=positions[:, :end],
                is_first_iteration=step == 0, past_key_values=cache, logits_to_keep=1, use_cache=True,
            )
            output = model(**kw, return_dict=True)
            cache = output.past_key_values
            raw = output.logits[:, -1]
            if step < limit - 1:
                scores.append(rank_mask(raw))
            if step in plan:
                before, down = partial["before"], partial["down"]
                reconstructed = model.lm_head(model.model.norm(before + down))[:, -1]
                torch.testing.assert_close(reconstructed, raw, atol=0, rtol=0)
                data.append((plan[step], partial["x"], before, down, raw.clone()))
                partial.clear()
    finally:
        for hook in hooks:
            hook.remove()
    support = support_identity(scores, caps)
    assert support == batch["support_sha256"]
    return data, support


def added_terminal_score(model, records):
    n = 0
    tensor = torch.zeros((8960, 1536), device=model.device)
    for events, x, before, down, raw in records:
        selected = [event for event in events if event["kind"] == "eos" and event["centered_reward"] != 0]
        if not selected:
            continue
        rows = [event["row"] for event in selected]
        target = torch.tensor([event["action"] for event in selected], device=model.device)
        masked = rank_mask(raw[rows])
        counts = masked.isfinite().sum(-1)
        support = masked.topk(int(counts.max()))
        found = (support.indices == target[:, None]) & support.values.isfinite()
        assert bool((found.sum(-1) == 1).all())
        coordinates = found.to(torch.long).argmax(-1)
        norm = model.model.norm
        atoms = model.lm_head.weight[support.indices].float()
        feedback = analytical_feedback(
            (before + down)[rows, -1].float(), norm.weight.float(), norm.variance_epsilon,
            atoms, support.values, coordinates,
        )
        weights = torch.tensor([event["centered_reward"] for event in selected], device=model.device)
        tensor.addmm_(x[rows, -1].float().T, feedback * weights[:, None])
        n += len(rows)
    assert n == 16
    return tensor


def compare_distributions(original, shifted):
    reference = rank_mask(original)
    alternative = rank_mask(shifted)
    previous_support = reference.isfinite()
    old = reference.softmax(-1)[:, list(EOS)].sum(-1)
    stop = alternative.softmax(-1)[:, list(EOS)].sum(-1)
    count = previous_support.sum(-1)
    support = reference.topk(int(count.max()))
    valid = support.values.isfinite()
    fixed = shifted.gather(1, support.indices).double().masked_fill(~valid, -torch.inf)
    log_reference = support.values.double().log_softmax(-1)
    log_alternative = fixed.log_softmax(-1)
    terms = log_reference.exp() * (log_reference - log_alternative)
    kl = terms.masked_fill(~valid, 0.0).sum(-1).clamp_min(0.0)
    changed = (previous_support != alternative.isfinite()).any(-1)
    return old.tolist(), stop.tolist(), kl.tolist(), changed.tolist()


def diagnostic(model, prepared, weights):
    console = Console()
    records, supports = [], []
    for index, batch in enumerate(prepared["replay_batches"]):
        retained, support = capture(model, batch, prepared["observations"][8 * index:8 * index + 8])
        records.extend(retained)
        supports.append(support)
        console.print(f"Replayed and matched support for adaptation batch {index + 1}/2.")
    terminal_sum = added_terminal_score(model, records)
    content_size = prepared["candidate_writes"]["scored_tokens"]
    content_norm = prepared["candidate_writes"]["unscaled_gradient_norms"]["exact"]
    content_sum = weights["exact"] * (2 * content_norm * content_size)
    combined = content_sum + terminal_sum
    ratio = float(terminal_sum.double().norm() / content_sum.double().norm())
    angle = float((combined.double() * content_sum.double()).sum() / (combined.double().norm() * content_sum.double().norm()))
    weights["exact_with_eos"] = combined * (0.5 / float(combined.double().norm()))
    output = []
    for events, x, before, down, raw in records:
        rows = [event["row"] for event in events]
        observed = [dict(event) for event in events]
        for arm, write in weights.items():
            for name, scale in (("full", 1.0), ("quarter", 0.25)):
                perturbation = (x.float() @ (write * scale)).to(down.dtype)
                new = model.lm_head(model.model.norm(before + (down + perturbation)))[:, -1]
                old, stop, kl, changed = compare_distributions(raw[rows], new[rows])
                for event, base, probability, divergence, moves in zip(observed, old, stop, kl, changed, strict=True):
                    event["zero_eos_mass"] = base
                    event[f"{arm}_{name}"] = {"eos_mass": probability, "fixed_support_kl": divergence,
                                              "dynamic_support_changed": moves}
        output.extend(observed)
    assert sum(row["kind"] == "eos" for row in output) == 64
    return {"records": output, "matched_support_sha256": supports, "eos_to_content_numerator_norm": ratio,
            "combined_direction_cosine": angle}


@torch.inference_mode()
def main(checkpoint, manifest, adaptation, candidate, output):
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("highest")
    prepared = read(adaptation)
    assert prepared["gate"]["passed"] and prepared["checkpoint_sha256"] == LFS_SHA
    assert fingerprint(candidate) == prepared["candidate_writes"]["sha256"]
    verify(checkpoint, manifest)
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(checkpoint, dtype=torch.bfloat16, local_files_only=True,
                                                trust_remote_code=False, use_safetensors=True).to("cuda").eval()
    model.requires_grad_(False)
    assert tuple(model.generation_config.eos_token_id) == EOS
    weights = {name: value.cuda() for name, value in load(candidate.read_bytes()).items()}
    result = diagnostic(model, prepared, weights)
    result.update({"adaptation_sha256": fingerprint(adaptation), "candidate_writes_sha256": fingerprint(candidate),
                   "checkpoint_sha256": LFS_SHA, "checkpoint_revision": REVISION, "gpu": torch.cuda.get_device_name(),
                   "content_stride": STRIDE, "eos_ids": EOS})
    with output.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(result, stream, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":"))
        stream.write("\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if not __debug__:
        raise RuntimeError("The termination diagnostic requires Python assertions.")
    main(*(Path(value) for value in sys.argv[1:]))

eos_support_fixture.py.content:
"""Exercise fixed-support KL independently of dynamic stopping mass."""

import torch

from eos_credit_diagnostic import EOS, compare_distributions


reference = torch.full((1, 151936), -20.0)
reference[0, :50] = torch.linspace(3.0, 1.0, 50)
identical = compare_distributions(reference, reference)
assert identical == ([0.0], [0.0], [0.0], [False])
shifted = reference.clone()
shifted[0, EOS[0]] = 8.0
old, stop, kl, support_changed = compare_distributions(reference, shifted)
assert old == [0.0] and stop[0] > 0.5 and kl == [0.0] and support_changed == [True]
shifted[0, 0] = 5.0
_, _, kl, changed = compare_distributions(reference, shifted)
assert kl[0] > 0.0 and changed == [True]
print("Fixed-support KL and dynamic EOS mass crossed the expected independent controls.")
